      import pandas as pd
      import numpy as np

      np.random.seed(42)

      n = 500

      cgpa = np.round(np.random.uniform(5.5, 9.8, n), 2)
      attendance = np.random.randint(60, 100, n)
      aptitude = np.random.randint(50, 100, n)
      programming = np.random.randint(50, 100, n)
      communication = np.random.randint(50, 100, n)
      internship = np.random.randint(0, 2, n)

      placement = (
      (cgpa >= 7.5) &
      (attendance >= 75) &
      (aptitude >= 70) &
      (programming >= 70)
      ).astype(int)

      df = pd.DataFrame({
      "CGPA": cgpa,
      "Attendance": attendance,
      "Aptitude": aptitude,
      "Programming": programming,
      "Communication": communication,
      "Internship": internship,
      "Placement": placement
      })

      df.to_csv("student_data.csv", index=False)

      print("student_data.csv created successfully!")
      student_data.csv created successfully!
